_note: Every reason_code the risk job writes to risk_scores, with the names of its reason_params. The app turns code + params into a sentence in English, Hindi or Urdu (one message per code). place = weather point id from jobs/points.json (translate by id). exposure = very_high | high | some | low. black_ice = yes | no. Numbers are rounded like the English reason. jobs/tests/test_reasons.py checks the job only writes what is listed here.
